note: The three ring spans that carry `data-foil` (foil handoff R1), each scrolled to a tile with the film, at both widths. On local-dev as the headless account (user_3Hdjdoc…): FOIL_SEARCH is a card it holds in one printing, all foil (e.g. Ambush Viper; 67 such cards on 2026-10-14), FOIL_DECK a deck holding one (d0000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000cafe holds Jeska's Will, all foil), and the precon row needs seeded precons (Avengers Assemble, MSC, is 100 of 100 foil). The film is static at rest; the hover band is not photographed (pnpm probe:foil-film proves it). Tokens, suggestions and precon box tiles never carry it.
